Talk to us
Which classes and subjects do you teach?+

We offer Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry for Classes 9–12, and French for Classes 4–9. Mathematics support covers CBSE, ICSE, and English-medium State Boards. Contact us to discuss your specific syllabus.

How do online classes work?+

Classes take place online with interactive teaching and guided practice. Contact the team to confirm the class platform, schedule, and any materials you will need.

Can I try a class before enrolling?+

Yes. You can request a free demo through our booking form. The team will coordinate the subject and timing with you.

Do you teach students in Canada?+

Yes. The published tuition fee for students in Canada is CAD 15 per hour for all subjects and grades. Contact us to confirm subject availability and a suitable time.

Where can I see the tuition fees?+

All published hourly rates are listed on our Fees page. Rates in India vary by class and subject; Canadian rates are listed separately.
